1.1: This Peter, one of Jesus Christ's apostles, writin' to all the folks scattered across Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia—y'all God's chosen ones on the move.
1.2: Y'all were picked ahead of time by God the Father, set apart by the Spirit, so you could live obedient and get covered by the blood of Jesus. Much love and deep peace to all y'all—may it multiply heavy.
1.3: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! 'Cause of His wild mercy, He gave us new life—a living hope—through Jesus risin' from the dead.
1.4: And now we got an inheritance that can't get messed up, can't be corrupted, and won't ever fade. It's sittin' in heaven, just waitin' for you.
1.5: And you? You stay protected by God's power, through your faith, holdin' on 'til salvation gets fully revealed when the time comes.
1.6: So yeah, you celebrate—even though for now, you might be goin' through it with all kinds of trials.
1.7: But it's all a test to show how real your faith is. That faith? It's more valuable than gold, even though gold gotta go through fire. When Jesus come back, your faith gon' shine with praise, honor, and glory.
1.8: You ain't seen Him, but you still love Him. You don't see Him right now, but you believe in Him—and that got you filled with joy so deep it can't even be explained. Pure glory.
1.9: 'Cause what's comin' at the end of this journey? The salvation of your soul. That's the goal.
1.10: The prophets was searchin' hard for this same salvation—they prophesied about the grace that's hittin' y'all now.
1.11: They kept diggin' to figure out the time and situation the Spirit of Christ in them was pointin' to—about how the Messiah would suffer and then be glorified.
1.12: God showed them that it wasn't about them—it was for us. What they spoke on came to life through the folks who preached the gospel to y'all by the Holy Spirit from heaven. Even angels wanna peek into this—fr fr.
1.13: So lock in your mind. Get your mental right. Stay clear-headed and put your full hope in the grace that's gon' hit when Jesus come back.
1.14: Be obedient like kids who actually listen—don't fall back into your old lusts like you did when you ain't know no better.
1.15: But just like the One who called you is holy, you be holy too—in everything you do.
1.17: And if you call God "Father," the same One who judges everybody fairly based on how they live—then carry yourself with reverence while you here on earth. This ain't your forever home.
1.18: You ain't get saved with stuff that fades like silver or gold—stuff passed down from your folks that didn't really lead nowhere.
1.19: Nah—you were bought with blood. Not just any blood—the precious blood of Christ, like a perfect lamb with no blemish.
1.20: Jesus was chosen for this before the world was even made, but now He stepped into the scene for you—in these last days.
1.21: Through Him, you believe in God—the One who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory—so your faith and hope could stay rooted in God.
1.22: Since y'all cleaned up your souls by obeyin' the truth—through the Spirit—and now got that real, deep love for your fam in Christ, love each other hard, with pure hearts.
1.23: You been born again—not from no weak, fading seed—but from something that can't die: the livin', everlastin' word of God.
1.24: 'Cause: "All people like grass, And all their glory like a flower— The grass dries up, The flower falls off,
1.25: But the word of the Lord? That joint lasts forever." And that right there—that's the word y'all heard in the gospel.

2.1: So, for real—cut out all the mess: hate, lies, fakin', jealousy, and that reckless mouth.
2.2: Like babies fresh out the womb, crave that pure Word—it's how you grow up in this walk.
2.3: 'Cause if you ever really tasted how good the Lord is, you already know what it is.
2.4: Come to Jesus—the realest one, the livin' stone. Folks might've rejected Him, but God chose Him and calls Him precious.
2.5: And y'all? Y'all livin' stones too. God buildin' somethin' spiritual with you—a whole priesthood, holy and set apart—to bring spiritual offerings that actually please Him through Christ.
2.6: The Scriptures said it: "Look, I'm puttin' down a cornerstone in Zion, Chosen, valuable, the real foundation. Whoever believe in Him won't be ashamed."
2.7: To the believers, He's priceless. But to the ones who don't obey: "The stone the builders tossed aside Ended up bein' the main piece."
2.8: And also: "A rock that trips people up, A stone they stumble over." They fall 'cause they don't wanna listen—and they was already headed that way.
2.9: But you? You different. Chosen generation. Royal priesthood. Holy nation. God's own people. So you can show the world who He is—the One who pulled you outta darkness and lit up your whole life.
2.10: Back then, you wasn't even a people. Now? You God's people. Back then, no mercy. Now? Full access. 💯
2.11: Family, I'm beggin' you—as folks just passin' through this world—stay away from them cravings that try to destroy your soul.
2.12: Live in a way that even when folks talk bad about you, your good deeds shine so hard they end up givin' glory to God when He show up.
2.13: Submit to the laws of the land for the Lord's sake. Whether it's the king or governors—
2.14: They been set up to keep wrongdoers in check and uplift those who do right.
2.15: This God's will: that when you live right, you shut up the foolish talk of ignorant folks.
2.16: You free, yeah—but don't use that freedom to hide bad behavior. Live like God's servants.
2.17: Show respect to everybody. Love your people. Fear God. Respect the ones in charge.
2.18: If you servin' somebody, respect 'em—even the ones that ain't treatin' you right.
2.19: If you endure unjust suffering because you're tryna stay faithful to God, that hits different in His eyes.
2.20: I mean, if you get beat for doin' wrong and take it… that ain't special. But if you do right and still get mistreated, and take that with grace? God honors that.
2.21: This is part of the call—Christ suffered for us and left the blueprint. You supposed to walk in them same steps.
2.22: "He ain't never sinned. Never spoke a lie."
2.23: When folks came for Him, He ain't snap back. When He was sufferin', He ain't threaten nobody. He gave it all over to the One who judges right.
2.24: He carried our sins in His own body—on that cross. So we could die to sin and live for righteousness. And by His wounds? We got healed. 🙌
2.25: You was out here like lost sheep. But now? You home. Back with the Shepherd. Back with the One watchin' over your soul.

3.1: Wives, same way—be respectful and submitted to your own husbands. Even if your man ain't followin' the Word, your lifestyle might be the thing that wins him over—no sermon needed.
3.2: When he sees you movin' with purity and reverence, that's gon' speak for itself.
3.3: Don't just be all about the outside—your hair, your gold, your outfits.
3.4: Let your real beauty be what's inside—a soft, quiet spirit that don't fade. God sees that and calls it precious.
3.5: That's how the OG holy women did it—trustin' God, lovin' their husbands, and stayin' faithful.
3.6: Just like Sarah did with Abraham, callin' him lord. If you walk like that, doin' right and not shakin' in fear, you part of her line.
3.7: Husbands, same goes for y'all—live with your wife in understanding. Show her honor, even if she seem more fragile. Y'all both heirs of this grace-life. Don't block your own prayers bein' outta pocket with her.
3.8: Look, fam—y'all need to be on the same page. Show love. Show empathy. Be tender, humble, and respectful.
3.9: Don't clap back when folks do you wrong. Don't trade insult for insult. Instead, bless them—'cause that's your calling. And that's how you receive your own blessing. 🙌
3.10: "If you wanna live good and see good days, Keep your mouth from talkin' reckless, And don't be out here spreadin' lies.
3.11: Step away from evil and chase what's good. Run after peace like it's a prize."
3.12: The Lord stay watchin' out for the righteous—He hear they prayers. But if you out here actin' up? His face turn the other way.
3.13: Who really gon' mess with you if you stay doin' good?
3.14: But even if they do come for you while you walkin' right—you still blessed. Don't be shook or stressed about their threats.
3.15: Keep God set apart in your heart. Be ready to break down why you got hope—do it humbly and respectfully.
3.16: Keep your conscience clean. So when haters throw dirt on your name, your life gon' expose their lies and leave 'em embarrassed.
3.17: If God allows you to suffer, better it be for doin' right than for doin' wrong.
3.18: Jesus took on suffering too—once and for all. The righteous One died for the unrighteous ones. Why? To bring us close to God. His body died, but the Spirit raised Him up.
3.19: Through that same Spirit, He went and made a move—preached to the souls locked up.
3.20: These were the ones who ain't listen back in Noah's time, while God was patiently waitin' and the ark was bein' built. Only eight folks made it out that water.
3.21: And that same water points to what baptism means for us now—it ain't just about gettin' washed on the outside. It's a sign you got a clean conscience with God, made real through Jesus risin' from the dead.
3.22: And now Jesus sittin' at God's right hand—above every angel, authority, and power. All of it answers to Him now. Crowned up. 👑

4.1: Since Christ went through suffering in His body, you need to suit up with that same mindset. 'Cause when you suffer in the flesh and stay faithful? That's a sign you done with sin.
4.2: You don't waste the rest of your life chasin' what people want—but you live for what God want now.
4.3: We already did enough wildin' in the past—livin' like the world: wild parties, lust, gettin' drunk, worshippin' false stuff. That was then.
4.4: Now folks tryna figure out why you don't run with 'em no more in that same mess. They talkin' reckless 'cause you don't move like them.
4.5: But trust—everybody gon' have to answer to the One who ready to judge both the livin' and the dead.
4.6: That's why the gospel was preached even to folks who gone already—so that even though they were judged by human standards, they could live by God's Spirit.
4.7: The end is close—so lock in. Be serious and alert when you pray.
4.8: Most important, love each other hard. 'Cause real love covers a whole lotta mess.
4.9: Be the kind of person that opens your door and your heart—no grumbling, no side-eye.
4.10: Whatever gift God gave you, use it to serve each other. Be a good steward of His grace—don't sit on what He gave.
4.11: If you speak, speak like God talkin' through you. If you serve, serve with God's strength—so everything lifts Him up. Glory and power? All that belongs to Jesus—forever. Amen. 🙌
4.12: Fam, don't act brand new when fiery trials come. That's not strange—it's part of the walk.
4.13: Instead, rejoice that you get to share in Christ's suffering. 'Cause when He shows up in glory? You gon' be shoutin' too.
4.14: If folks talk down on you 'cause you reppin' Christ, that's actually a blessing. That means God's glory restin' on you—even if they don't get it.
4.15: But don't be out here sufferin' 'cause you doin' wrong—don't be a killer, a thief, a menace, or out here nose-deep in other folks' business.
4.16: But if you catch heat just 'cause you a Christian? Don't be ashamed. Let that be your chance to glorify God.
4.17: Time's up—judgment startin' in the church. If it begins with us, what's it gon' look like for folks who ain't even listenin' to the gospel?
4.18: Like the Word say: "If the righteous barely make it, Where the sinner and the godless gon' end up?"
4.19: So if you suffer and it's God's will, put your soul in His hands and keep doin' good—He a faithful Creator. Trust that.

5.1: To all the elders among y'all—I'm speakin' as a fellow elder, someone who saw what Christ went through and who gon' share in that glory when it's revealed:
5.2: Take care of God's people like a true shepherd. Don't do it just 'cause you got to—do it 'cause you want to. Don't do it for the money bag—do it with a willing heart.
5.3: Don't be out here flexin' on the people God trusted you to lead. Be the example. Let 'em follow your walk, not just your words.
5.4: And when the Chief Shepherd—Jesus—comes back, He got a crown of glory for you. And unlike everything else, it won't fade or get dusty. 👑
5.5: Same thing goes for the younger crew—respect the elders. And all of y'all? Be humble with each other. Wrap yourself in humility like a fresh fit. 'Cause: "God push back on the proud, But He pour grace on the humble."
5.6: So drop your pride, and stay low under God's mighty hand. He gon' lift you up when the time's right.
5.7: And whatever stress, whatever weight you carry? Throw it all on Him—'cause He actually care about you. 👐
5.8: Stay woke. Stay locked in. The devil out here like a lion—roamin', roarin', lookin' for someone to chew up and spit out.
5.9: But you? Stand strong. Don't fold. Keep your faith solid. Know this: your brothers and sisters across the world goin' through the same battles. You ain't alone. 💪🏾
5.10: And after you've suffered a lil' while, the God of all grace—the One who called you into eternal glory through Jesus—He gon' perfect you, establish you, strengthen you, and settle you.
5.11: All the glory and power? It's His. Forever and ever. Amen. 🙌🏾
5.12: I wrote this short letter through my brother Silvanus, who I trust fully. I'm encouragin' y'all and lettin' you know: this is the real deal—the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
5.13: The one with me in Babylon—chosen just like you—sends love. So does my son Mark.
5.14: Show love to each other with a holy kiss. Peace to every single one of y'all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
